Learn repeated tasks daily

Optional. Successful Fast Phone Use goal summaries are stored privately on this phone and grouped via your ChatGPT login, at most once daily. No full chats, screenshots or entered text. User tasks take priority; missed analysis catches up when possible. Learned hints never grant permission or replay clicks.
